_notes.p1.organization: SUSPECTED BUG: rubric says 6. The logo is the relative IRI 'logo.png' on /docs/, which resolves to /docs/logo.png (200). The scorer joins it onto the scope root without a trailing slash (urljoin('.../docs', 'logo.png') = '/logo.png', 404) and scores 5.
_notes._sampled: SUSPECTED BUG: /docs-legacy/old-install.html is sampled. Scope filtering is a bare startswith('/docs'), so the sibling folder /docs-legacy counts as inside /docs; depth_in_scope then calls it nested ('-legacy/old-install.html').
_notes._sample_source: SUSPECTED BUG: run() finds /docs/sitemap.xml for p1.sitemap (the subpath fallback), but discover() only tries origin sitemaps, so the sample ignores it: /docs/guides/troubleshoot-proxy.html (sitemap only) is never sampled and the report says 'no sitemap reachable' next to a sitemap it scored.
